readiness.reason: Cell ROLL-AA (board route F2, docs/handoff/2026-09-24-fable51/HANDOFF-STAGE3-FOR-CHATGPT-v1.md section 7.3): the within-flight A/A null of the Stage-3 variant-rollout methodology. READINESS HELD. Every roster-bound preparation cell ROLL-1 needed is already SEALED and is inherited by hash in this cell's baseline (the R01C featcache packet promotion, the intent-boundary speech-query encoding and the model-free content derivative all close over a SUPERSET of these rows and are read by id). What does NOT exist yet is this cell's OWN model-free first-phase supply (item E16: a prepared artifact is evidence only for the implementation that produced it, so nothing is inherited from ROLL-1) and the root-admission decision receipt. 'requirements' is deliberately EMPTY rather than a PENDING placeholder pair: core.flight.repin._set_preparation_requirement CREATES the preparation requirement on the first successful preparation and _upsert_decision_requirement INSERTS the decision requirement at the flip, while a placeholder decision entry without an expected_decision_id would be left behind beside the real one and refuse the campaign at load (core.flight.campaign.declared_readiness). Nothing here authorises a flight, a readiness flip, a contact or an admission entry.

requirements.reason: Model-free first-phase supply prepared by core.flight.repin on the launch commit; zero model, tokenizer or encoder contact.

failure_policy: Stop and preserve on the first failure. No automatic restart, replay, row filtering, roster, role-graph, prompt, knowledge, geometry or cap change. This registration pre-authorises no recovery; a root-diagnosed recovery re-registration is a separate act once the cell is flown. A partial manifest is never read.

generation_budget.definition: 2600 = 200 rows x 13 and 52 = 4 rows x 13, where 13 is the grouped-Solver graph's OWN ceiling at samples 2 as rails.native_episode_config.load_native_episode_config resolves it: perception.max_iterations + (max_revisions + 1) x (solver.max_iterations x solver.samples + reviewer.max_iterations + planner.max_iterations) = 1 + 2 x (1 x 2 + 3 + 1). The ceiling is a BOUND, never a target: the expected spend is about 5.2 contacts per row (cell CELL-1 measured 4.216 at samples 1; the group adds one Solver contact per visit), i.e. about 1,040 contacts on the arm, so the registered ceiling is about 2.5x the expectation. Budgets are run-cumulative across every attempt of a run id.

population.decision_population: The first 4 rows, in roster order, of the clean construction subset SLURP-STAGE3-CONSTRUCTION-R01C, committed as docs/receipts/rosters/slurp-stage3-roll-aa-r01c-smoke-4-v1.json (SLURP-STAGE3-ROLL-AA-R01C-SMOKE-4-V1). Structural smoke only.

purpose: Cell ROLL-AA four-row structural smoke (board route F2, docs/handoff/2026-09-24-fable51/HANDOFF-STAGE3-FOR-CHATGPT-v1.md section 7.3): the same greedy-repeat N = 2 Solver group on the first four rows of the ROLL-AA roster, for structural acceptance only -- two raw Solver samples in solver_group custody per row (I7g), no tools array, every request fits. It produces no null and no number.

stage3_algorithm.note: ROLL-AA exercises the SAME algorithm-neutral rollout substrate cell ROLL-1 registered -- the grouped Solver, its custody and its commit -- and applies no learned context of its own. It is the A/A NULL of that substrate: two greedy repeats of one prompt, so the paired per-row difference it measures is the methodology's own measurement floor rather than any operator's effect. Declared 'shared-rollout' for exactly that reason; it is not a family arm and carries no credit_assignment or update operator.
